claims.text: Cold spraying nanostructured nickel-based alloy powder onto 316 stainless steel or nickel-base superalloys will produce a nanocrystalline gradient microstructure.
The cold-sprayed repair will substantially improve wear resistance relative to fusion-welded repairs and untreated surfaces.
The cold-sprayed repair will substantially improve corrosion resistance relative to fusion-welded repairs and untreated surfaces.
The cold-sprayed repair will substantially reduce hot cracking relative to fusion-welded repairs and untreated surfaces.
A gas-stream velocity of approximately 600–1200 m/s is suitable for the proposed cold-spray deposition.
Nanostructured nickel-based alloy powder with particle sizes below 20 μm is suitable for the proposed repair.
Maintaining the substrate below 300°C is an applicable processing boundary for the proposed repair.
High-velocity particle impact induces severe plastic deformation in the deposited particles.
Impact-induced severe plastic deformation triggers adiabatic shear and dynamic recrystallization.
Dynamic recrystallization during impact forms a nanocrystalline gradient microstructure.
The resulting microstructure enables robust mechanical interlocking with the substrate.
The resulting microstructure reduces residual-stress concentrations.
The resulting microstructure inhibits crack initiation and propagation.
Cold spraying produces a dense, fine-grained coating that adheres strongly to the substrate.
The graded cold-sprayed microstructure minimizes thermal gradients and residual-stress buildup relative to fusion welding.
The cold-sprayed repair will increase microhardness by approximately 30–50%.
The cold-sprayed repair will minimize thermal distortion relative to fusion-welding repair.
The cold-sprayed repair will minimize associated emissions.
Traditional fusion-welding repair involves high heat input that creates thermal gradients and residual stresses.
The proposed process is applicable to localized repair of 316 stainless steel and nickel-based superalloy components exposed to combined corrosive and wear stresses.
